title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E03 — Breaking Brig
An armored transport bus crashes, resulting in the escape of four prisoners -- including a black market broker topping the list of national security threats; Pride needs Gibbs' help with a case file full of redactions.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E12 — Sister City: Part Two
Special Agent Pride and the team investigate a Russian sleeper agent involved with Abby's brother; Sebastian goes to Washington, D.C., to work with Abby; Bishop drives all night to deliver a package and help the New Orleans team.

title: NCIS
description:
S17 E09 — IRL
The NCIS team investigates a petty officer's murder that was livestreamed on a popular gaming app; Gibbs watches his 11-year-old neighbor when his mom must leave on a last-minute trip.

title: NCIS
description:
S17 E05 — Wide Awake
NCIS investigates Marine Cpl. Laney Alimonte after evidence suggests she murdered her neighbor while being treated for insomnia by a hypnotherapist; Gibbs befriends his new neighbors after the 9-year-old's baseball crashes through his window.

title: NCIS
description:
S20 E19 — In the Spotlight
Agent Knight goes viral for saving a mother and child from a potentially fatal car accident.

title: NCIS
description:
S20 E20 — Second Opinion
NCIS works to solve the murder of a senator's daughter who has a rebellious reputation and large online following; Jimmy gets competitive with an old college rival.

title: NCIS
description:
S20 E21 — Kompromat
NCIS must investigate a string of Russian spy encounters that may be linked to a suspicious murder; Jimmy accidentally makes a confession that could change the course of his relationship with Knight.

title: NCIS
description:
S17 E07 — No Vacancy
While investigating a Marine's murder, the NCIS team uncovers a labyrinth of live-streaming spy cameras hidden in the rooms of a Virginia motel.

title: NCIS
description:
S17 E06 — Institutionalized
After a petty officer's son is found murdered, evidence suggests Kasie's lifelong best friend is guilty.

title: NCIS
description:
S17 E14 — On Fire
After Torres and Bishop are victims of a hit-and-run, Torres fights for his life in the Intensive Care Unit.

title: NCIS
description:
S17 E10 — The North Pole
Gibbs and the team assist Ziva with "the one thing" she said she would need to take care of before returning to see her family.

title: FBI
description:

The team investigates an extremist gun group after an anti-gun lobbyist building is bombed; SAC Bashar dangles a possible promotion for OA.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E15 — Scar Tissue
The team realize they have a cross-country serial killer on their hands; the case has ties to Isobel's father, Robert, and his hotel, leading to revelations about their fractured relationship.

title: Practical Magic
description: Raised by their aunts, two sisters born into a magical family use different means to avoid a family legacy of witchcraft.

title: You've Got Mail
description: Boutique bookseller Kathleen hates Joe, the owner of a corporate Foxbooks chain store that just moved in across the street. When they meet online, however, they begin an intense and anonymous Internet romance, oblivious of each other's true identity.

NCIS agents McGee and Torres head to New Orleans to partner with Pride and his team in the search for the missing homeland security theoretical terror playbook.

While Pride fights for his life in the ICU, the team scours the city for the hit woman who attempted to assassinate him.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E14 — A New Dawn
A petty officer is murdered while in town to help a refugee family; Wade works on the special election campaign for Mayor Zahra Taylor that takes place during Mardi Gras.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E15 — The Last Mile
FBI Special Agent Raymond Isler asks Pride for help with an off-the-books opioids theft investigation he is personally invested in; Percy works undercover as a getaway driver, with Isler as the muscle for a job tied to the case.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

A congressional aide disappears after a hit man saves her from two men posing as NCIS agents; LaSalle struggles with life-altering decisions regarding his brother's future.

Gibbs must face the reality of his actions after he assists Ziva with "the one thing" she said she would need to take care of before returning to her family.

title: NCIS
description:
S17 E12 — Flight Plan
The NCIS team investigates an F-18 crash and the subsequent disappearance of the pilot; McGee reluctantly discusses a very personal decision with his teammates.

title: NCIS
description:
S18 E01 — Sturgeon Season
Gibbs and Fornell attempt to track down the leader of a drug ring who supplied drugs to Fornell's daughter; the team deals with the case of a missing cadaver from the NCIS autopsy room.

title: NCIS
description:
S18 E02 — Everything Starts Somewhere
Flashbacks reveal the murder case that first introduced young Gibbs to NCIS and to Ducky.

title: NCIS
description:
S18 E03 — Blood and Treasure
The discovery of two dead bodies in a forest leads the NCIS team into the wild world of modern-day treasure hunting; Gibbs and Fornell get deeper into their search for the opioid kingpin.

title: NCIS
description:

The team must protect Ziva's father when his attendance at a convention leads to surprises.

title: NCIS
description:
S08 E09 — Enemies Domestic
Following a deadly attack, one member of the team reminisces.

title: NCIS
description:
S08 E10 — False Witness
A Naval petty officer and sole witness in an upcoming murder trial disappears.

title: NCIS
description:
S08 E11 — Ships in the Night
The team partners with a Coast Guard Investigative Service agent to solve the murder of a Marine on a dinner boat.

title: NCIS
description:
S08 E12 — Recruited
Dr. Mallard's predecessor, Dr. Magnus, joins the team to help solve a murder at a college fair.

title: NCIS
description:
S08 E13 — Freedom
The team investigates when a Marine is found beaten to death in his backyard.

title: NCIS
description:
S08 E14 — A Man Walks Into a Bar ...
While investigating a naval commander's death, the team undergoes required psych evaluations.

title: Criminal Minds
description:

The BAU team investigates when the remains of a dozen people are discovered along a creek bed in Yakima, Wash.

title: Criminal Minds
description:

The BAU believes two unsubs may be operating simultaneously when victims killed in two different ways are discovered in the same city; the team grapples with keeping Reid safe in prison.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E18 — Hell's Kitchen
The BAU investigates an urban vampire who kidnaps his victims at night and holds them underground in the sewer system; Reid makes a difficult decision in prison.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E02 — To a Better Place
The BAU investigates three similar crimes in which victims' remains are discovered in old suitcases.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E14 — Collision Course
The BAU looks into the cause of several fatal car crashes involving drivers and pedestrians; Reid gets bad news.

title: Criminal Minds
description:

The BAU investigates a series of disfiguring acid attacks on young men and women; Dr. Reid begins to settle into his new surroundings.

title: Criminal Minds
description:

A mother steps forward with valuable information for the BAU to aid in their investigation of an unsub known as the bone crusher; Reid must adapt to a new set of rules in prison.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E24 — Poetic Justice
Unable to trust anyone in New Orleans, the NCIS team calls in FBI Assistant Director Isler to help expose and stop Mayor Hamilton's sinister scheme.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E17 — Treasure Hunt
The team investigates the murder of a Navy captain who was searching for a priceless 200-year-old fleur-de-lis during the annual Louisiana Pirate Festival.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E18 — Welcome to the Jungle
Pride, Sebastian and Tammy travel to South America after Pride is personally requested by a former colleague to assist with a classified operation that has been compromised.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E19 — High Stakes
Percy and LaSalle go undercover at a high-stakes poker game after the organizer targets players with access to a naval research laboratory; Laurel Pride visits her dad during spring break to discuss options after her upcoming graduation.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E20 — Powder Keg
Pride and his bar patrons are held hostage by a group of volatile thieves.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E21 — Mind Games
Gregorio calls on her former behavioral science professor when the team's latest case matches one she studied during FBI training.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E22 — The Assassination of Dwayne Pride
A journalist posts a scathing article documenting Pride's "reckless use of justice"; the team is concerned about the fallout from the piece and the confidential information revealed; Rita Devereaux tells Pride it is a coordinated attack on him.

title: Law & Order
description:
S16 E09 — Criminal Law
When detectives investigate a series of seemingly random murders, they find a hit list that includes Jack McCoy; he realizes the people on the list are jurors from trial of a multiple murderer he prosecuted years ago.

title: Law & Order
description:
S16 E10 — Acid
When Lt. Van Buren's college friend's daughter is found dead, she leads a no-holds-barred mission to catch the serial assailant who attacked her in the past.

title: Law & Order
description:
S15 E17 — License to Kill
McCoy and Borgia target the unlikely hero who pursued a mass murderer through the streets of Manhattan in a deadly car chase that left one dead and one injured.

title: Law & Order
description:
S15 E18 — Dining Out
A celebrity chef comes under suspicion in the murder of a TV network executive when Fontana and Green learn that the two were having an affair and the chef's cooking show was about to be canceled.

title: Law & Order
description:
S15 E19 — Sects
While investigating a woman's murder, Fontana and Green uncover a cult that encourages sexual relations with children, and Borgia determines to put away its mesmerizing leader (Deborah Hedwall).

title: Law & Order
description:
S15 E20 — Tombstone
A promiscuous lawyer ends up bludgeoned to death in her office, and detectives treat her former lovers as suspects until DNA evidence points to a co-worker.

title: Law & Order
description:
S15 E03 — The Brotherhood
The death of a prison gang member leads Fontana and Green to suspect the victim's former associates until they learn the deceased also had a running battle with a hard-nosed corrections officer.

title: Law & Order
description:
S15 E04 — Coming Down Hard
Detectives investigate the deaths of two college students and find both were participating in a pharmaceutical company's secret testing program for an antidepressant that has resulted in many suicides.

title: Law & Order
description:
S15 E05 — Gunplay
An illegal firearms sting backfires when two officers are slain, and Green poses as a gun buyer to try to capture the killers, who were able to identify the officers via a Website identifying undercover cops.

title: Law & Order
description:
S15 E06 — Cut
McCoy must determine whether charges should be filed in civil court or in criminal court when a novelist's death seems to have been caused by careless liposuction, but Branch finds a recurring pattern of negligence by the doctor.

title: Law & Order
description:
S15 E07 — Gov Love
McCoy takes the issue of gay marriage before the state's Supreme Court when he is unable to compel a man to testify against a crooked developer because the two say they are married.

title: Law & Order
description:
S16 E02 — Flaw
Fontana and Green seek the aid of Detective Olivia Benson; they discover a money-laundering scheme involving a mother-daughter team Benson had dealt with in a past case.

title: Law & Order
description:
S16 E03 — Ghosts
A criminal makes a startling deathbed confession; Detective Fontana reopens a 10-year-old case file concerning the murder of a 12-year-old girl.

title: Law & Order
description:
S16 E08 — New York Minute
Detectives link the owner of a trucking company to the smuggling of illegal aliens and suspect a citizen border-patrol member of his killing.

title: Law & Order
description:
S17 E01 — Fame
Tabloid photography may have played a role in a fatal burglary attempt; ADAs Jack McCoy and Consuela Rubirosa argue the use of shield laws to protect celebrity journalism.

title: Law & Order
description:
S17 E02 — Avatar
An Internet photo of a murdered woman provokes a slew of 911 calls.

title: Law & Order
description:
S15 E21 — Publish and Perish
Fontana and Falco (Michael Imperioli) must tread lightly when they discover links between a powerful police commissioner and the murders of an infamous porn actress and a maverick publisher.

title: Law & Order
description:
S16 E16 — Cost of Capital
A murder victim, a young banking associate, has hundreds of thousands of dollars in a checking account, which may be a clue to the case.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E16 — Protective Details
After an immigration agent is fatally shot at a hockey game, the team attempts to find the shooter, who they believe may also be targeting Congressman Curtis Grange, who was at the same game.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E17 — One Night Stand
When a young couple is found murdered in a New York City park after returning from a vacation, the team searches for a suspect linked to the drug trade; Scola turns over a new leaf when it comes to his relationships.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E18 — Fear Nothing
OA is forced to confront one of his biggest fears when the team discovers that deadly sarin gas may have been sold to terrorists.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E19 — Face Off
When a morning show host is murdered inside her home, the team tracks the killer; things become awkward for Scola when agent Nina Chase becomes part of the team during Maggie's recovery.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E20 — Ghost From the Past
A killer is using drug mules to exploit airport security checkpoints; OA struggles to cope with the aftermath of the sarin gas exposure and the 10th anniversary of his army friend's death in Afghanistan.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E21 — Kayla
When a retired Drug Enforcement Administration agent is shot outside a bakery, the team works to determine if the victim's past cases or current bouncer job are connected to the murder; Nina and Tiffany clash over the use of an informant.

title: Scorpion
description:
S03 E17 — Don't Burst My Bubble
Team Scorpion must move Happy's friend Ada, and the sterile bubble Ada lives in that protects her compromised immune system, to a secure location after a severe storm leaves the structure surrounded by dangerous debris.

title: Scorpion
description:
S03 E18 — Monkey See, Monkey Poo
To stop a dangerous virus from spreading, Team Scorpion must locate an endangered monkey in the Amazon that has the antibody for the cure; Toby and Happy see a counselor to prepare for matrimony.

title: Scorpion
description:
S03 E19 — Broken Wind
The team races to save Paige and Happy when a wire supporting the gondola they are in during a mission to repair a turbine at a wind farm snaps.

title: NCIS
description:
S08 E15 — Defiance
After a suicide bomber tries to assassinate the Belgravian Defense minister, the team must protect his daughter, who is studying in the U.S.; Gibbs looks into the death of a Marine who was killed in the bombing.

title: NCIS
description:
S08 E16 — Kill Screen
A murdered Marine's fingertips and teeth are found in a stolen purse.
